wins: Completed initial network discovery quickly, identifying 3 live hosts and 2 open service ports within the first 5 steps.
Captured SMB share listings using smbclient that revealed potential credential files for further analysis.
fails: Unable to convert gathered service banners into valid credential pairs; brute force attempts against SSH/SMB stopped after 3 attempts without success.
No successful privilege escalation despite locating writable scripts on target host, indicating missing payload handling.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase shows promise with rapid asset awareness, but credential acquisition and escalation remain blockers, keeping success rate at 0%.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Credential brute-force attempts were repeatedly throttled by account lockouts, failing to pivot into the host despite valid usernames.
Privilege escalation scripts executed without sufficient data about environment variables, resulting in access denied responses.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB shares list accessible and anonymous login succeeds
skill_cards.then_action: Use smbclient to list share contents and search for credential files

skill_cards.if_condition: When valid usernames known but login fails repeatedly
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to targeted Hydra with low-frequency delay to avoid lockouts

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in quickly cataloging SSH service information during reconnaissance
Reliable retrieval of SMB share insight that feeds downstream credential discovery

next_experiments.title: Implement slow-rate credential spraying
next_experiments.description: Deploy CredSpray with a low request rate (1 attempt per 5 seconds) against both SSH and SMB services to reduce lockouts while probing known usernames.

next_experiments.title: Automate writable script analysis
next_experiments.description: Enumerate writable paths via enumeration and run linpeas to catalog potential sudo misconfigurations before executing privilege escalation payloads.

next_experiments.title: Chase SMB laddering context
next_experiments.description: Use smbmap with recursive file reads to extract configuration files for further context on domain users and service secrets.
